description: Apply a common text description update to multiple of your own time entries. Supply ids (list of time-report ids, max 100) and text (the new description). Returns per-id results — partial failures are reported rather than aborting the whole batch.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

ids.description: Ids of the time entries to update (max 100).

text.description: New description to apply to all entries (max 1000 characters).

name: bulk_update_time_reports
